messages.content:
Two groups of adults had systolic blood pressure measured.
Group A: n = 25, mean = 132.4 mmHg, SD = 10.2.
Group B: n = 30, mean = 126.1 mmHg, SD = 11.8.
Assuming equal variances, compute the pooled standard deviation and the 95% confidence interval for the difference in means (A minus B) using the t distribution. Give both to two decimals.
End with exactly one line: ANSWER: pooled_sd=<x>; ci=(<lo>, <hi>)

Let me work through this step by step.

Given:
- Group A: n₁ = 25, mean₁ = 132.4, SD₁ = 10.2
- Group B: n₂ = 30, mean₂ = 126.1, SD₂ = 11.8

**Step 1: Pooled standard deviation**

The pooled variance formula:
s_p² = [(n₁ - 1)s₁² + (n₂ - 1)s₂²] / (n₁ + n₂ - 2)

s₁² = 10.2² = 104.04
s₂² = 11.8² = 139.24

s_p² = [(25 - 1)(104.04) + (30 - 1)(139.24)] / (25 + 30 - 2)
s_p² = [24 × 104.04 + 29 × 139.24] / 53
s_p² = [2496.96 + 4037.96] / 53
s_p² = 6534.92 / 53
s_p² = 123.3004...

s_p = √123.3004 = 11.1041...

Let me be more precise:
24 × 104.04 = 2496.96
29 × 139.24 = 4037.96
Sum = 6534.92
6534.92 / 53 = 123.300377358...

s_p = √123.300377358 = 11.10407...

Rounded to two decimals: 11.10

**Step 2: 95% CI for the difference in means (A - B)**

Difference in means: 132.4 - 126.1 = 6.3

Standard error of the difference:
SE = s_p × √(1/n₁ + 1/n₂)
SE = 11.10407 × √(1/25 + 1/30)
SE = 11.10407 × √(0.04 + 0.033333...)
SE = 11.10407 × √(0.073333...)
SE = 11.10407 × 0.270799...

Let me compute √(0.073333...) more precisely:

1/30 = 0.0333333...
Sum = 0.0733333...
√0.0733333 = 0.270799...

SE = 11.10407 × 0.270799 = 3.00697...

11.10407 × 0.270799
= 11.10407 × 0.27 + 11.10407 × 0.000799
= 2.99810 + 0.00887
= 3.00697

Degrees of freedom: n₁ + n₂ - 2 = 53

For df = 53, the two-tailed t value at α = 0.05 is approximately 2.0057.

CI: 6.3 ± 6.03108
